name: pulse-implementation
description: Implements approved React component plans in this Laravel Inertia app. Use after discovery, requirements, architecture, API, accessibility, performance, and testing decisions are made, to edit component, hook, helper, style, and test files following local conventions.
purpose: Translate approved component decisions into code that follows React 19, TypeScript, Inertia, Tailwind, Radix, Motion, and local project conventions.
single_responsibility: Translate approved component decisions into scoped code changes that follow React 19, TypeScript, Inertia, Tailwind, Radix, Motion, and local project conventions.
triggers: An approved plan is clear enough to edit files
The user approved implementation of a component, bug fix, or refactor
Outputs from design and test skills are ready to apply in code
outputs: Test or verification changes when needed
completion_criteria: Code changes are applied using local patterns and stay scoped to the task
Outputs from upstream design and test skills are reflected in the code
The smallest reliable checks were run or explicitly reported as skipped
An implementation summary names the files changed
validation_criteria: Verification ran or was reported as skipped
failure_handling: If implementation reveals a boundary, API, or dependency issue beyond the plan, stop and route back instead of silently expanding scope.
When blocked, report the files changed, the checks run or skipped, and the residual risks.
escalation_path: Route uncertain Inertia, React, Motion, Radix, Tailwind, testing, or Vite APIs through pulse-docs-research.
Route boundary or structure problems to pulse-architecture-boundaries and public API changes to pulse-api-contract.
Escalate new dependencies, asset-loading, or SSR boundary changes to the user.
non_responsibilities: Rewriting the architecture mid-implementation without surfacing why.
